panel.$description: Content surface: panels, the sidebar, fields, tables. White. The second and last surface level. Same value as surface.raised today, with another role.

head.$description: Head strip of a panel (eis-panel__head). Text on it is --ink: --ink-muted fails there (4.2:1). Not a page surface.

selected.$description: Background of a selected table row (aria-selected=true; a checked checkbox does not select the row). Every text role still passes on it: ink 16.6:1, ink-muted 4.5:1, accent-ink 5.0:1. Not a page surface.

hover.$description: Background of a closed disclosure summary under the pointer. Text on it is --ink (15.7:1); --ink-muted fails there (4.3:1), so muted helpers in the summary take --ink on hover. Not a page surface.

raised.$description: Background of a default button: a control raised above the canvas. Same value as surface.panel today, with another role (a control, not a content area). Not for page areas.

inverse.$description: Active nav item, primary button, solid tag.

$root.$description: Fills and marks for the one thing that matters: overdue, conflict, urgent.

ink.$description: Accent as text: overdue dates, current breadcrumb.

on.$description: Text placed on a accent fill.

$root.$description: Fill for a positive state: done, saved, sent. Use sparingly; it never competes with the accent.

on.$description: Text placed on a success fill.

$root.$description: Fill for a destructive action on hover (eis-button--danger). Never decoration.

ink.$description: Danger as text and as the border of a danger button.

on.$description: Text placed on a danger fill.
